notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
[h2]What I am working on for 2022?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761801/a6f264e4d910d6d44c48854681ad289fc28cc8d3.png[/img]

Have you ever dreamt of playing as a Chinese Warlord in the 1920's?

Behind the scenes, high-ranking warlord officers are negotiating a comfortable future for themselves in exchange for betraying their masters while Jiang Jieshi is plotting with the Green Gang to get rid of his communist allies.

This is a time of dishonest plots and brutal action.

Have fun!

Some candidates are: 
-Turning the game into a really multiplayer one
-Adding the possibiliy to let the AI manage some of your fronts

Tell me!

notes.title: Cauldrons of War Stalingrad is officially released
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497230?utm_source=SteamNews&utm_campaign=Barbarossa][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761801/8920474714d073dc060fe04c4185aed9aed64fa5.png[/img][/url]

From Crimea to Stalingrad and the Caucasus oil fields, lead the Axis or the Soviet forces in the bitter fightings of the eastern Front in 1942.

Cauldrons of War - Stalingrad is an immersive 'command at the highest level'  wargame with tough decisions to make.
Its clean mechanics and low complexity allows the game to focus on what is really important : strategical decisions.
There is no micromanagement here, but more depth than you imagine.

[h2]Play the main operations in 1942 on the eastern Front :[/h2] 
As the German, will you grasp the Baku oilfields ? As the Soviet, will you trap a whole German army near Stalingrad ?

[h2]Play fast and often [/h2]: you don't need a 100+ hours investment in a monster game. Some scenarios can be played in 1 or 2 hour. But don't worry, the game contains several scenarios and is challenging enough to keep you entertained for a long time.

[h2]Play against the AI or against your friends[/h2] : with a hot seat mode and a Play By Email Mode 

Cauldrons of War - Stalingrad is the second opus of the "Cauldrons series".
If ever you have played Cauldrons of War - Barbarsossa, you won't be disoriented, but you will notice some improvements here and there.

I am pretty sure you will enjoy the Stalingrad City scenario playable at company scale.
This is a whole new Cauldrons of War experience. ==> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497230?utm_source=SteamNews&utm_campaign=Barbarossa]Get it here[/url]

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: QUALITY OF LIFE OVERHAUL
notes.content:
It was a promise, it is now done.

Cauldrons of War Stalingrad being finished*, I've just pickup some of its new features to increase the CoW Barbarossa quality of life.

So, What is new?

[h2]Tooltips everywhere & Minimap[/h2]

I know most of you weren't big fan of consulting the wiki: now, you will just have to hover elements in the operation window long enough to make the tooltip appear.

If you hover an action sending a unit somewhere else, a minimap will appear so you won't need to close the operation window to check where exactly on the map you are sending this unit.

This feature alone will change your life.

[h2]A new map and new display options[/h2]

Most of the "old maps" are still in the game, but I have added the Stalingrad Map as the default map.
You may like the new button on the left :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761801/8ad4f2304d075b1cbc7a5bf97fe4781ad50c5735.png[/img]

Click on it to Display the troops on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761801/590ba639ca06c511f3374c5af877fbd388f7f4b8.png[/img]

Now you can quickly visualize if you are really weak somewhere.

[h2]Other minor changes[/h2]

PBEM : 
-those damn load game buttons are now easy to click
-That damn PBEM folder is easy to find and open (I've added a button to do so)

English event texts:
-They have been reviewed one more time (Thank You Red_Jar), so you should find less misspellings and typos)

Bugs:
-They should now be even rarer (mostly those bugs that produced strange results at turn change)


Have Fun!

Maestro Cinetik

*PS: for those of you who don't own yet Cauldrons of War Stalingrad, it is the best moment to get it, before I raise its price for the official release (this is a matter of days)

notes.title: Cauldrons of War Stalingrad - The HQ Management patch
notes.content:
CoW Stalingrad is evolving fast and some of its features will be added to CoW Barbarossa

[h2]You can now transfer ressources between your Army groups or Fronts.[/h2]

This may not succeed however :

Generals were constantly asking for reinforcements and those had to be taken from other Army groups whose general would fight not to let their assets go...

You can now too play this petty games.
Click on your Fronts or Army Groups : you will see a new HQ icon along your armies. This icon gives you access to new actions :
- Ask for more trucks
- Ask for more reserves
- Ask for more aircrafts

If playing as the Axis, you ma be offered the possibility to activate Army Group Crimea if it isn't active.

This new transfer feature has been playested in the previous days and seems to work fine. I hope you will enjoy it.

[h2]Other minor features[/h2]

-Turkey can now directly besiege Batumi
-Giant Pockets have been added to the western part of the Caucasus
-A new Axis event have been added in the case the Army Group Center destroys all the soviets units in Rhzev or Orel.
(Some of these features have been added since a week or two , but they are now well tested and debugged, so they make it to the "official patch")

[h2]Become a bug buster[/h2]

In the menu, I've added a "bug report" button : this feature will greatly facilitate my bug hunt.

Here is a list of some of the recently killed bugs:

-Some Buggy operations have been fixed : Narva, Kharkov, The Caucasus Giant Pockets
-You now really score points as the Soviet for taking Kharkov
-If you send aircrafts to "briefly" help Model, you won't lose them next turn.
-You no longer spend 2 Command points to fight partisans in cleaning operations.

Many other minor bugs have fallen, but I just keep track of the "Star Bugs".


[h2]The Stalingrad City Scenario[/h2]

Still in progress...
I am testing a lot of ideas... and discard a lot of them.
But I am starting to get satisfied.

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

notes.title: The Cauldrons of War - Stalingrad Store page is now open
notes.content:
Hello,

CoW Stalingrad is progressing well, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497230/Cauldrons_of_War__Stalingra]the Steam Store page is now open[/url].


[previewyoutube=RV4M7Mp94Ow;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are the contents and features:
(As the game is still a work in progress some of these may change)

[h2]Scenarios[/h2]

[b]For the early release [/b]:
-Fall Blau from june to november 42
-Edelweiss (centered on the Caucasus campaign alone, that will be a fast played scenario)
-First fruits (the early Kharkov and Crimean May 42 operations)
-A longer version of Fall Blau, from may 42 to December 42

[b]For the final Game[/b] :
-Uranus and Jupiter
-Wintergewitter
-Two small scale city centered Stalingrad scenarios on their own particular map

[h2]Other features and improvments[/h2]

-The possibility to delegate an Army Group management to the AI
-An "Axis firmness score" : if this score is too low, the Axis minor forces will be less efficient
-A "Focus on Moscow" score for the Soviet : while it is too high, you may be unable to send forces South
-Air superiority may now triggers some automatic strike against your oppenent during its actions
-Small scale units may be supplied by horse drawn carts where the trucks can't pass
-The Human wave soviet actions will only be available on some particular operations
-New operations terrains types like steppe, dense woods, mountain ... 
-A Maskirovka effect for the soviet player who will be able to hide entire armies!
-The Turcs may join the feast if the german player performs well in the Caucasus
-As the operations may reach Iran, you may even see some british unit
-Some new unit traits to simulate obsolete equipment or heavy siege guns

And many other thinks I may have forgotten to mention.

There is still a lot of work to be done, but step by step, the game is taking shape.

notes.title: Some news about Cauldrons of War Stalingrad
notes.content:
The Cauldrons of War Stalingrad sequel is progressing well, and many features i am testing on it will end up in CoW Barbarossa.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761801/55bc19add52d1a489bc932f89be4364595fd9f64.png[/img]

Here is a sneak peak on the Edelweiss scenario. : [url=http://cauldronsofwar.com/index.php/edelweiss-scenario-analysis-german-point-of-view/]Edelweiss[/url]

That Edelweiss campaign will be the most difficult of the game (for the german) due to insane goals.
You have to pierce through strong soviet defences while the time is quickly running away  and the OKW is taking your units away to support the advance toward Stalingrad.

The keys of that scenario are : 

- Destroying as many soviet armies as you can in the steppe, before you reach the Caucasus mountains
- Carefully select your goals
- Adapt quickly to the many changing situations and swiching OKW priorities.


I will post regularly some contents about the game until the release.

Have fun !

notes.title: Rostov Patch
notes.content:

[b]As the Svir junction is accomplished, Finland HQ will be connected to southern operations[/b]
You will be able to use your clever winter proofed finnish troops in some new places now.  

[b]The 2nd german army is now splitable [/b]
Really, i don't know why it was not the case earlier...

Also in this patch : some minor text and bug fixes.

Now you have no excuses for not winning as the german !

Have fun!

Maestro Cinetik

Hello there!

Cheat codes :

-They can only be triggered once per session
-They exist to help you explore deeper the game, more than to help you cheat

Type simultaneously "C" for cheat and :

-"P" to add 1 command point to each of your HQs

-"A" to add 10 planes to each of your HQs

notes.title: Cauldrons of War official release september 25th
notes.content:
Lead the operations on the eastern front at the highest strategical level.

Cauldrons of War is a simple but deep turn-based wargame about the invasion of USSR by nazi germany in 1941.

In this game, as the commander in chief, you won't  micro-manage lesser issues, but will focus on the great strategical affairs. The game stay tense, but you won't have to play 120 hours to finish a campaign, [u]and that alone will change your wargamer's life[/u].

This game features :

- 4 scenarios about the operations Barbarossa, Typhoon, the Moscow counter-offensive and the 1941-1942 soviet winter offensive

- A hot seat mod

- A PBEM mod

Have fun !

Maestro Cinetik
